title: Flex Online MBA: Virtual Info Session
description:
Discover Your Future with Texas A&M’s Online MBA!

Ready to take your career to the next level—on your terms? Join us for a 30-minute virtual session where you’ll explore the powerful benefits of earning your MBA online from Texas A&M University. Learn how our flexible, top-tier program can fit your life and fuel your goals. 

Bring your questions and your curiosity—we’re excited to meet you!

RSVP Here!

title: Go Global with Mays
description:
Go Global with Mays!
Ready to take your degree across borders? Join us for the Go Global with Mays event to discover how an international experience can transform your career.
  • When: April 15 | 10 AM – 2 PM
  • Where: Wehner Lobby & Wayne Roberts Building
What to expect:
  • Explore: Browse various faculty-led, exchange, and internship programs.
  • Fund: Get the scoop on scholarships and financial resources.
  • Connect: Chat with students who have already been abroad and hear their stories.

title: AI Venture Velocity Challenge
description:
The competition will highlight the best AI-related businesses from undergraduate/graduate student founders across the country. Individuals and teams will compete in three rounds:

  • Written Business Plan Round: Submit written business plans to Mays Business School by May 1, 2026.
  • Virtual Pitch Round: 24 entires will be selected from all submissions to present a 10-minute pitch virtually July 1, 2026.
  • Final Round of In-Person Pitches: The top 12 entires will advance to compete at Mays Business School at Texas A&M University in College Station, Texas, on Sept. 25-26, 2026.

Winners will receive significant cash prizes, including $100,000 for first place, $50,000 for second place, and $25,000 for third place.

 

Learn more here.
